notes.title: Corrections and optimizations
notes.notes:
[h3][b]#Bug fixing[/b][/h3]

- Correction of internal problems in some phases.
- We have removed the audio setting from the start screen. Changing the setting before starting the game would negatively affect the experience.
- Game optimization

[h3][b]#Localization:[/b][/h3]

Correction and optimization of translated text
Addition of fallback fonts.

This update had a lot of help from [b]Iwan Gabovitch[/b], thank you!
